name: JBLE-Langley
description: Home to Air Combat Command headquarters and the 633d Air Base Wing. A key East Coast fighter and command base in the Hampton Roads region supporting ACC and joint operations.

currentNotifications.title: Gate Access Reminders
currentNotifications.body: LaSalle Gate (Main) and Armistead Gate are primary 24/7 access points. Visitor Control Center at LaSalle Gate open 0700-1700 daily. REAL ID required.

gates.name: LaSalle Gate (Main Gate)
gates.notes: Primary gate with Visitor Control Center (Bldg 5). Daily 0700-1700 for visitor processing and passes.
gates.address: LaSalle Gate, Langley AFB, Hampton, VA 23665

gates.name: Armistead Gate (West)
gates.notes: 24/7 alternate access point. Useful for off-hours arrivals.
gates.address: Armistead Gate, Langley AFB, Hampton, VA 23665

gates.name: King Street Gate
gates.notes: Secondary access point with limited hours.
gates.address: King Street Gate, Langley AFB, Hampton, VA 23665

gates.name: Visitor Control Center (Bldg 5)

gates.address: Bldg 5, outside LaSalle Gate, Langley AFB, Hampton, VA 23665

events.title: Breakfast Burrito Mondays
events.description: Breakfast at the Bistro IS BACK EVERY MONDAY! 7:30 to 9:30 AM! New bulk pre-order option! Pay & order in-person at the Bistro by 10 AM Friday & pick up Monday morning.

events.title: Outdoor Rec Summer Rentals
events.description: June 24 through September 18. Cost: $45/day Kayaks. paddleboards and canoes.

events.title: Jiu Jitsu Self Defense Classes
events.description: Get ready to roll! Learn effective self-defense techniques, enhance physical fitness & mental resilience, develop discipline, focus & confidence, and connect with your community in a supportive environment! Instructor: Zachary Darroch – IBJJF Black Belt with The Academy/Honey Badger BJJ Las Vegas, NV (certification #79742) Free and open to all with base access!

events.title: Dog Days at Eaglewood
events.description: Banish sad puppy eyes today! Enjoy a round with your best friend when you bring your pooch along.

events.title: Storytime (2 time slots)
events.description: Take a journey through the alphabet at storytime with stories, crafts, and activities. Storytime is at 9:30 and 11 am. Both times arethe same storytime, so choose the time that works best for your family!

events.title: Story Time
events.description: Join us Wednesdays at 10:30 AM and 11 AM for stories, songs, and activities with new friends at the Bateman Library. September theme is Alphabet, and both sessions are identical. Just pick the time that works best for you!

events.title: Cosmic Bowling
events.description: Every Saturday!* Cost: $10 kids 13 & under | $13 ages 13+ Shoe rentals are included in the price. *Excludes special events.

events.title: September Serving Heroes Community Dinner

events.title: Bass Fishing Tournament
events.description: Fishing Tournament hours: 6 am to 3 pm. Sign-in at 5:30 am | weigh-in at 3 pm. Tournaments are subject to change due to scheduling conflicts or weather. Must be 16 years of age or older to enter, must be 18 years of age or older to rent a boat.

To register: https://www.signupgenius.com/go/10C084CA4AF22A3F5CE9-63582008-3rdannualsuicide?useFullSite=true#/ Location: ACC Fitness Trail.

sections.title: Required Documents
sections.body: PCS orders, CAC, medical/dental records. REAL ID or equivalent required for base access. Sponsor required for visitors without DoD ID.

sections.title: In-Processing Schedule
sections.body: Report to gaining unit normal business hours (Mon-Fri 0730-1630). After-hours arrivals report to Langley Inn (757-764-4667). Single members contact CDMO at 37 Cedar Ave — do not sign into lodging if assigned to dorms.

sections.title: Housing
sections.body: Langley Inn for temporary lodging. Hunt Military Communities for privatized on-base housing (757-920-7100). CDMO at 757-764-4090 for dorms.

sections.title: Quick Resources
sections.body: 633 FSS, M&FRC, and official JBLE sites for in-processing and community support.

sections.title: Sponsor Program
sections.body: Your sponsor should meet you upon arrival. Contact M&FRC if no sponsor is assigned before departure.
